text: Automatic adjustment mechanisms trade democratic input for responsiveness: by removing policy changes from the legislative agenda they limit opportunities for public debate and scrutiny, which raises accountability and transparency concerns.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Future of Law - Dynamic Web3 Governance (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4957318

isBasedOn.name: The Future of Law - Dynamic Web3 Governance

abstract: Another challenge is the potential reduction in legislative oversight and democratic input, as these mechanisms may limit opportunities for public debate and scrutiny of ongoing policy adjustments, raising concerns about accountability and transparency.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: where adjustment is triggered automatically without legislative revisiting
